title: A Comparative View of the Phlogistic and Antiphlogistic Theories
lineage: The inspected pages document several small-whole-number particle combinations before Dalton. They do not establish whether relative-atomic-weight tables appear elsewhere in the full work.

passages.note: Printed pp. 12–15 / source PDF pp. 34–37: ultimate particles and a proposed 1:2 combination.
Printed pp. 132–135 / source PDF pp. 154–157: examples with one particle and two through five other particles, with force diagrams.

file.method: Selected pages extracted from the full scan; all nine mapped pages were raster-compared at 45 dpi.
